title: Software Engineer II — Backend (Kirana Club)
snippet:
About the Team
We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every week after that.

Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you own your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be.

What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.

Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review,
